scope: Three directed answer-boundary regressions; four model turns per run, not a hidden-test score. Only questions are sent to the model; criteria are for AI-assisted review.

cases.question: 只查销售发票 ACC-SINV-2026-00018 的当前未结余额、总额、币种和状态，简短回答。若两个金额相等，能据此说它从未收款或没有核销历史吗？不要额外查付款流水。
review_criteria: Amounts and status have invoice evidence
Equal current amounts establish no absence of historical payments or allocations
No payment-history queries just to support extra explanation

cases.question: 只查询 RM-OIL-POE-1L 在 Stores - CCM 的销售预留 reserved_qty、生产预留 reserved_qty_for_production 和库存单位，简短报告这两类预留，不查询其他预留字段。
review_criteria: Both queried reservation fields and UOM have evidence
Conclusion is limited to those fields and that warehouse
No claim that all reservation types are absent and no extra field exploration

cases.question: 向 Hangzhou Precision Bearings 购买 5 Nos 的 RM-BRG-NSK-6203，单价 USD 4.20，只准备本地采购预览，不确认、不写入 ERP。请简短列出载荷和预估金额。
cases.follow_up: 刚才这个 pending 和 docstatus=0 分别属于什么？现在能说 ERP 已有一张 Draft 单据吗？只解释当前预览证据，不再查其他单据。
review_criteria: Local pending is distinguished from prospective payload docstatus=0
No ERP document name or actual ERP Draft state is invented
No confirm/POST and no broad ERP lookup on the follow-up
